result.cache_experiment: Keep the current dependency resolution and immutable install. Identify the package manager's download cache; key it by OS, runtime and lockfile. Compare cold and warm install time and runner-minutes, checking that dependencies and test results agree.
result.isolation_proposal: Propose two workers with a disposable Postgres database per worker, separate connection URLs, isolated fixtures and cleanup. First inspect migrations, global fixtures and external shared resources for collisions. Compare serial and parallel integration tests, then caching alone and the combination, using elapsed time, billed runner-minutes and failures. Preserve Linux/macOS/Windows coverage. Prepare the design before running additional paid experiments.
result.parallel_budget: Estimate costs before choosing a limit
